clips.text: The real religious experience cannot be organized, taught or transmitted To systematize it is to kill it.

It is so living and moving and dynamic that to impose a pattern on it is impossible; and the experience is always so unique and individual that it cannot be put into any category - although it happens when the individual is not.
It cannot be followed, for everyone has to find it for himself, and that is the beauty of it, and also its freedom and virginity.

It is not new in the sense of any opposition to the old, it is new in the sense of timelessness - that is, eternally fresh and innocent - as every flower is new and every sunrise is new and every love is new.
It is not borrowed from the past, it is not based on any tradition, it is not derived from without, it happens within, without any causality.
It is not continuous with the mind, it is a discontinuous explosion.
There are clouds in the sky and the sky cannot be seen, but there is no causal chain.
